fusions.name: Churned Landing
fusions.desc: Lands hard, throwing up earth that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and pushes them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Flung Dirt
fusions.desc: Flings a clod that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Dug-In Cover
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 26 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Fresh Mound
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a shield worth 10% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
